desc: Which gold table holds the holdings by month.

request.text: Which table has the holdings by month?

turns.name: Mei Chen
turns.text: Which gold table holds the cash by entity?

turns.name: Span
turns.text: The dashboards read 3 gold tables: gold_investment_report_holdings_monthly (Month-end holdings by entity in USD and SGD with the status of each value); gold_investment_report_cash_daily (Cash per entity per day, administrator view next to the trading view); gold_investment_report_benchmark_monthly (Portfolio return, benchmark return and the difference for each month, from recorded values).

turns.name: Mei Chen
turns.text: Which table has the holdings by month?

turns.name: Span
turns.text: gold_investment_report_benchmark_monthly is a gold table (ready for dashboards). Portfolio return, benchmark return and the difference for each month, from recorded values. Columns: benchmark_code, month, portfolio_return, benchmark_return, difference. It is built from valuation_observations, market_observations, benchmark_definitions, benchmark_components.
